title: Mars Climate Orbiter
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: Mars Climate Orbiter in its cruise layout: a 1.6 x 2.0 x 2.1 m bus (gold equipment module below, dark propulsion module above), the 640 N main engine and thruster clusters on top, the 1.3 m high-gain dish on its mast, and the single three-panel solar wing (5.5 m long) on one side, which made the spacecraft lopsided. On the equipment module: PMIRR with its cone-shaped cooler, the two small MARCI cameras, the UHF relay antenna, the battery box and star cameras. Simplified: instrument shapes and exact positions are best estimates from NASA artist's views; the wing is drawn 1.85 m wide.
